_note: Template for data/taxonomy.json (gitignored, your real taxonomy). Copy this file there and edit freely: the script uses that file both to build the tagging prompt and to validate the model's answers. Keys starting with _ are not axes. 'multi' indicates whether a post can have several values on that axis.
_instructions: You are an archivist cataloguing posts from <describe your page's topic>.
For each caption, assign the correct values for every axis of the taxonomy below.
- Use ONLY the listed values. Never invent new ones.
- If an axis cannot be determined from the caption, return an empty list [].
- Ignore hashtags: they carry no information.
